title: Policy
description: Execution policy attached to a Job or Task enforcing constrained autonomy.

allowed_skills.description: Whitelist of skill names permitted for execution. If empty, all skills allowed.

budget_cap.description: Total expense limit for the entire job tree.

budget_allocated.description: Portion of budget allocated exclusively to this task or sub-job.

budget_currency.description: Currency or credit unit for budget accounting.

custom_policy.description: Domain-specific policy extension fields passed transitively.
